item.title: 'One Battle After Another' wins 6 prizes including best picture at Britain’s BAFTA film awards

item.title: 2 surfers rescued after being caught in rip current off Cape Kiwanda Beach
item.description: Two surfers were rescued off of Cape Kiwanda Beach Saturday afternoon after they had been caught in a rip current in the waters, officials say.
